  282   #=============================================================================
  283   # Refreshing a battler's properties
  284   #=============================================================================
  285   def pbUpdate(fullChange = false)
  286     return if !@pokemon
  287     @pokemon.calc_stats
  288     @level          = @pokemon.level
  289     @hp             = @pokemon.hp
  290     @totalhp        = @pokemon.totalhp
  291     if !@effects[PBEffects::Transform]
  292       @attack       = @pokemon.attack
  293       @defense      = @pokemon.defense
  294       @spatk        = @pokemon.spatk
  295       @spdef        = @pokemon.spdef
  296       @speed        = @pokemon.speed
  297       if fullChange
  298         @types      = @pokemon.types
  299         @ability_id = @pokemon.ability_id
  300       end
  301     end
  302   end

  304   # Used to erase the battler of a Pokémon that has been caught.
  305   def pbReset
  306     @pokemon      = nil
  307     @pokemonIndex = -1
  308     @hp           = 0
  309     pbInitEffects(false)
  310     @participants = []
  311     # Reset status
  312     @status       = :NONE
  313     @statusCount  = 0
  314     # Reset choice
  315     @battle.pbClearChoice(@index)
  316   end
  317 
  318   # Update which Pokémon will gain Exp if this battler is defeated.
  319   def pbUpdateParticipants
  320     return if fainted? || !@battle.opposes?(@index)
  321     allOpposing.each do |b|
  322       @participants.push(b.pokemonIndex) if !@participants.include?(b.pokemonIndex)
  323     end
  324   end
